long_description:
Pink Rodeo presents, Wellness Round Up! — Stretch. Sip. Shop. Bring your friends for a fun girls' night out filled with movement, local shopping, and a fun atmosphere!

The details 📋
🗓️ Friday, October 23rd 2026
🧘‍♀️ Yoga on The Turf: 5:45-6:15 PM
🛍️ Sip & Shop: 7:00-9:00 PM
📍 Green Street Market — 209 SE Green St. Lee's Summit, MO

🧘‍♀️Pilates on the Turf - Ticketed — 5:45–6:15 PM
Start the evening with an outdoor mat Pilates session led by Body Bar Pilates on the turf. Whether you're a beginner or experienced, everyone is welcome! 
Included in your ticket 🎟️ 
* Guided Pilates session
* Mega Tea or Sipper from Diamond Nutrition
* Event goodies from Pink Rodeo Boutique
* Private vendor shopping
Spots are limited, so buy your ticket and don't forget to bring your mat!

🛍️ Shop 50+ Local Vendors — 7:00–9:00 PM — Open to the public! Browse a wide variety of local vendors including food, homemade products, clothing and more!

🥤 Beverage Bar by Diamond Nutrition 
Enjoy delicious loaded teas and refreshing drinks available throughout the evening! 

🍔 Dinner from local food trucks—coming soon!

Pilates requires a ticket, but spots are limited!
Interested in becoming a vendor? Fill out the link!
 https://forms.gle/FotKF6hyvqdHjDaH6

Also check out other Health & Wellness events in Lees Summit.
